--[[
	Word Finder  (LocalScript, client side)
	---------------------------------------------------------------
	• 499782 English words embedded (uncompressed) at the bottom of this script.
	• Type the start of a word (e.g. "way") and every word starting with it is listed.
	• Results are a virtualized list, so even 30,000+ matches scroll smoothly.
	• Drag the window by its title bar (mouse or touch). "–" minimizes, "×" closes.

	Setup: put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts
	       (or StarterGui). It builds its own ScreenGui in PlayerGui.

	Word sources: dwyl/english-words (Unlicense) + wordnik/wordlist (MIT),
	merged, lowercased, de-duplicated, sorted.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local ROW_HEIGHT = 22
local TITLE_HEIGHT = 36

local COLORS = {
	bg = Color3.fromRGB(24, 25, 30),
	bar = Color3.fromRGB(34, 36, 44),
	input = Color3.fromRGB(42, 44, 54),
	list = Color3.fromRGB(19, 20, 24),
	rowAlt = Color3.fromRGB(27, 28, 34),
	stroke = Color3.fromRGB(62, 65, 78),
	text = Color3.fromRGB(236, 237, 241),
	sub = Color3.fromRGB(150, 154, 168),
	close = Color3.fromRGB(200, 70, 70),
}
local ACCENT_HEX = "#5AA0FF"

local function make(className, props, parent)
	local inst = Instance.new(className)
	for key, value in pairs(props) do
		inst[key] = value
	end
	inst.Parent = parent
	return inst
end

local function corner(parent, radius)
	return make("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius) }, parent)
end

local function commas(n)
	local s = tostring(n)
	local out = s:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,"):reverse()
	if out:sub(1, 1) == "," then
		out = out:sub(2)
	end
	return out
end

local function Main(WORD_DATA)
	local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("WordFinder")
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end

	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
	if viewport.X < 10 then
		viewport = Vector2.new(1280, 720)
	end
	local WIDTH = math.clamp(viewport.X - 20, 220, 320)
	local HEIGHT = math.clamp(viewport.Y - 80, 240, 440)

	---------------------------------------------------------------- GUI
	local gui = make("ScreenGui", {
		Name = "WordFinder",
		ResetOnSpawn = false,
		ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
		DisplayOrder = 50,
	}, playerGui)

	local window = make("Frame", {
		Name = "Window",
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(WIDTH, HEIGHT),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -WIDTH / 2, 0.5, -HEIGHT / 2),
		BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.bg,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Active = true,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
	}, gui)
	corner(window, 10)
	make("UIStroke", { Color = COLORS.stroke, Thickness = 1 }, window)

	local titleBar = make("Frame", {
		Name = "TitleBar",
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, TITLE_HEIGHT),
		BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.bar,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Active = true,
	}, window)
	corner(titleBar, 10)
	make("Frame", { -- squares off the bar's bottom corners
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 10),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -10),
		BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.bar,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, titleBar)

	make("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 1, 0),
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		Text = "Word Finder",
		TextColor3 = COLORS.text,
		TextSize = 15,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	}, titleBar)

	local minButton = make("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 24),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -66, 0.5, -12),
		BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.input,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		Text = "–",
		TextColor3 = COLORS.text,
		TextSize = 16,
	}, titleBar)
	corner(minButton, 6)

	local closeButton = make("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 24),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0.5, -12),
		BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.close,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		Text = "×",
		TextColor3 = COLORS.text,
		TextSize = 18,
	}, titleBar)
	corner(closeButton, 6)

	local body = make("Frame", {
		Name = "Body",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, TITLE_HEIGHT),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -TITLE_HEIGHT),
	}, window)

	local searchBox = make("TextBox", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 34),
		BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.input,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ClearTextOnFocus = false,
		TextEditable = false,
		Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		PlaceholderText = "Loading words...",
		PlaceholderColor3 = COLORS.sub,
		Text = "",
		TextColor3 = COLORS.text,
		TextSize = 15,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
	}, body)
	corner(searchBox, 8)
	make("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10) }, searchBox)

	local status = make("TextLabel", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 48),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 18),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		RichText = true,
		Text = "Loading word list...",
		TextColor3 = COLORS.sub,
		TextSize = 12,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
	}, body)

	local list = make("ScrollingFrame", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 70),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -80),
		BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.list,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
		ScrollBarThickness = 6,
		ScrollBarImageColor3 = COLORS.sub,
		ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
		ElasticBehavior = Enum.ElasticBehavior.Never,
		VerticalScrollBarInset = Enum.ScrollBarInset.ScrollBar,
	}, body)
	corner(list, 8)

	local emptyLabel = make("TextLabel", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 70),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 60),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		Text = "No words found",
		TextColor3 = COLORS.sub,
		TextSize = 14,
		Visible = false,
	}, body)

	---------------------------------------------------------------- Dragging
	local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil, nil

	titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = window.Position
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	titleBar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragInput = input
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and input == dragInput then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			window.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end)

	---------------------------------------------------------------- Buttons
	local minimized = false
	minButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		minimized = not minimized
		body.Visible = not minimized
		window.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(WIDTH, minimized and TITLE_HEIGHT or HEIGHT)
		minButton.Text = minimized and "+" or "–"
	end)

	closeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		gui:Destroy()
	end)

	---------------------------------------------------------------- Virtualized results list
	local words = {}
	local rangeStart, rangeCount = 1, 0
	local currentPrefix = ""
	local generation = 0

	local rows = {}

	local function getRow(i)
		local row = rows[i]
		if not row then
			local frame = make("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_HEIGHT),
				BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.rowAlt,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
			}, list)
			local wordLabel = make("TextLabel", {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0),
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -58, 1, 0),
				Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
				RichText = true,
				Text = "",
				TextColor3 = COLORS.text,
				TextSize = 14,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			}, frame)
			local lengthLabel = make("TextLabel", {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Position = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 0),
				Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 1, 0),
				Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
				Text = "",
				TextColor3 = COLORS.sub,
				TextSize = 12,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
			}, frame)
			row = { frame = frame, word = wordLabel, length = lengthLabel, key = nil }
			rows[i] = row
		end
		return row
	end

	local function render()
		if body.Visible == false then
			return
		end
		local first = math.max(0, math.floor(list.CanvasPosition.Y / ROW_HEIGHT))
		local visibleCount = math.ceil(list.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y / ROW_HEIGHT) + 2
		local prefixLength = #currentPrefix

		for k = 1, visibleCount do
			local index = first + k - 1 -- 0-based position inside the result range
			local row = getRow(k)
			if index < rangeCount then
				local key = generation * 1e7 + index
				if row.key ~= key then
					row.key = key
					local word = words[rangeStart + index]
					row.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, index * ROW_HEIGHT)
					row.frame.BackgroundTransparency = (index % 2 == 0) and 1 or 0
					if prefixLength > 0 then
						row.word.Text = '<font color="' .. ACCENT_HEX .. '"><b>'
							.. word:sub(1, prefixLength) .. "</b></font>" .. word:sub(prefixLength + 1)
					else
						row.word.Text = word
					end
					row.length.Text = tostring(#word)
				end
				row.frame.Visible = true
			else
				row.key = nil
				row.frame.Visible = false
			end
		end
		for k = visibleCount + 1, #rows do
			rows[k].key = nil
			rows[k].frame.Visible = false
		end
	end

	---------------------------------------------------------------- Search (binary search on the sorted list)
	-- first index i such that words[i] >= target
	local function lowerBound(target)
		local lo, hi = 1, #words + 1
		while lo < hi do
			local mid = math.floor((lo + hi) / 2)
			if words[mid] < target then
				lo = mid + 1
			else
				hi = mid
			end
		end
		return lo
	end

	local function search(raw)
		local query = (string.lower(raw):gsub("[^a-z'%-]", ""))
		currentPrefix = query

		if query == "" then
			rangeStart, rangeCount = 1, #words
		else
			local a = lowerBound(query)
			local b = lowerBound(query .. "\127") -- just past the last word with this prefix
			rangeStart, rangeCount = a, b - a
		end

		generation += 1
		list.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, rangeCount * ROW_HEIGHT)
		list.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
		emptyLabel.Visible = rangeCount == 0

		if query == "" then
			status.Text = "Showing all <b>" .. commas(#words) .. "</b> words. Type to search."
		elseif rangeCount == 1 then
			status.Text = '<b>1</b> word starts with "' .. query .. '"'
		else
			status.Text = "<b>" .. commas(rangeCount) .. '</b> words start with "' .. query .. '"'
		end

		render()
	end

	list:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(render)
	list:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteWindowSize"):Connect(render)
	body:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(render)

	---------------------------------------------------------------- Load the word list
	task.wait() -- let the window draw before the split
	words = string.split(WORD_DATA, "\n")
	WORD_DATA = nil

	searchBox.TextEditable = true
	searchBox.PlaceholderText = "Type the start of a word, e.g. way"
	searchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		search(searchBox.Text)
	end)
	search(searchBox.Text)
end
